en: Slow Snail wakes up under a wet leaf. She carries her shell on her back like a little house.
She slides past a red flower. Slide, slide. She leaves a shiny silver line behind her.
A fast ant runs by. Zoom! 'Hurry up, Snail!' says Ant. Snail smiles. 'I like to go slowly.'
Slow Snail stops at a green lettuce leaf. Munch, munch. Yum!
The sun gets hot. Slow Snail pulls her soft body into her shell to rest in the shade.
Ant comes back, tired and hot. Snail says, 'Come and rest in the cool shade with me.'
id: Siput Pelan bangun di bawah daun yang basah. Ia membawa cangkang di punggungnya seperti rumah kecil.
Ia meluncur melewati bunga merah. Sret, sret. Ia meninggalkan garis perak yang mengilap di belakangnya.
Semut yang cepat berlari lewat. Wus! 'Ayo cepat, Siput!' kata Semut. Siput tersenyum. 'Aku suka berjalan pelan.'
Siput Pelan berhenti di daun selada hijau. Nyam, nyam. Enak!
Matahari mulai panas. Siput Pelan menarik tubuhnya yang lunak ke dalam cangkang untuk beristirahat di tempat teduh.
Semut kembali, lelah dan kepanasan. Siput berkata, 'Ayo istirahat di tempat yang sejuk bersamaku.'

readAloudNotes.en: Make a fist on your back for the shell and ask, 'Where is Snail's house?'
readAloudNotes.id: Kepalkan tangan di punggung sebagai cangkang dan tanyakan, 'Di mana rumah Siput?'

readAloudNotes.en: Slide one finger very slowly along your child's arm for the silver line.
readAloudNotes.id: Geser satu jari sangat pelan di lengan anak untuk garis perak.

readAloudNotes.en: Use a quick squeaky voice for Ant and a slow calm voice for Snail.
readAloudNotes.id: Gunakan suara cepat dan melengking untuk Semut, suara pelan dan tenang untuk Siput.

readAloudNotes.en: Pretend to munch a leaf and rub your tummy.
readAloudNotes.id: Pura-pura mengunyah daun lalu usap perut.

readAloudNotes.en: Curl up small together like a snail in its shell.
readAloudNotes.id: Meringkuk kecil bersama seperti siput di dalam cangkangnya.

readAloudNotes.en: Ask, 'What a kind friend! What did Snail share?' before you answer together.
readAloudNotes.id: Tanyakan, 'Teman yang baik! Apa yang dibagi Siput?' sebelum menjawab bersama.

objectives.en: Learns two true things about snails: they carry a shell and they like damp, shady places.
objectives.id: Mempelajari dua fakta tentang siput: membawa cangkang dan menyukai tempat lembap serta teduh.

connection.en: Snails carry their shells, eat leaves, and hide from hot sun in damp shady places.
connection.id: Siput membawa cangkang, makan daun, dan bersembunyi dari panas di tempat lembap yang teduh.

discussionPrompts.id: Apakah kadang baik berjalan pelan? Kapan?

discussionPrompts.en: How was Snail kind to Ant?
discussionPrompts.id: Bagaimana Siput bersikap baik kepada Semut?

offlineActivity.en: After rain, go on a slow 'snail walk' in a garden or park. Look under leaves for snails and silver trails, but just look, without picking them up. Wash hands afterwards.
offlineActivity.id: Setelah hujan, berjalan pelan seperti siput di kebun atau taman. Cari siput dan jejak perak di bawah daun, cukup dilihat tanpa diambil. Cuci tangan sesudahnya.

factChecks.claim: Snails carry a shell on their backs.
Snails leave a shiny slime trail.
Many garden snails eat leaves and prefer damp, shady places.

safetyNotes.en: Look at snails without touching them, and wash hands after the garden walk.
safetyNotes.id: Lihat siput tanpa menyentuhnya, dan cuci tangan setelah berjalan di kebun.
